courseDetails.longDescription:
Este curso utiliza inteligência artificial.

A empresa gasta mais com salários a cada ano, e as pessoas continuam saindo por uma oferta um pouco maior. Aqui você encontra 133 ferramentas para fazer as recompensas funcionarem: 96 checklists, modelos, fórmulas, procedimentos e listas de perguntas prontos para uso, 32 modelos e métodos e 5 serviços demonstrados na tela.

Abra uma aula, escolha a ferramenta e aplique na sua próxima decisão sobre recompensas.

Por que aumentar os gastos não resolve

Os salários são definidos caso a caso, os bônus são pagos por costume e os benefícios são escolhidos porque outra empresa os oferece. Ninguém conectou essas partes nem perguntou o que os colaboradores realmente valorizam. Assim, cada aumento resolve uma conversa e gera a próxima, enquanto o orçamento de recompensas cresce sem tornar a empresa mais atrativa.

O que muda depois deste curso

Você passa a ter uma estratégia de Total Rewards vinculada aos objetivos do negócio. Define faixas salariais com dados de mercado e conecta remuneração a desempenho. Estrutura comissões de vendas, bônus e benefícios que as pessoas entendem e valorizam. Planeja o orçamento de recompensas, mede seu impacto e o conecta ao reconhecimento, à cultura e à EVP.

O que você encontra: 133 ferramentas, contadas aula por aula

Você pode conferir esse número. Abra qualquer aula e leia a descrição: todas as ferramentas estão listadas pelo nome.

  • 16 recursos para download: as apresentações das aulas
  • 96 ferramentas prontas para uso nas apresentações:
  • 22 checklists
  • 22 modelos e exemplos de documentos
  • 18 fórmulas e conjuntos de indicadores
  • 12 procedimentos passo a passo
  • 12 listas de perguntas e roteiros
  • 8 quadros de avaliação, tabelas e matrizes
  • 1 prompt de aI pronto para uso
  • 1 outra ferramenta prática
  • 32 modelos e métodos explicados: modelo de Total Rewards, método Hay Guide Chart-Profile, avaliação de cargos por pontos e fatores, broadbanding, teoria dos dois fatores de Herzberg
  • 5 serviços demonstrados na tela: ChatGPT, Indeed, Bonusly, Slack e 15Five

Onde estão as ferramentas

  • Estratégia e elaboração de Total Rewards (15 ferramentas). Componentes, estratégia, elaboração do programa e comunicação.
  • Remuneração, benefícios e estruturas salariais (73 ferramentas). Avaliação de cargos, análises de mercado, remuneração de vendas, níveis de cargos, remuneração executiva, remuneração por desempenho, benefícios e incentivos financeiros.
  • Orçamento, eficácia, EVP e cultura (49 ferramentas). Orçamento de recompensas, ROI, reconhecimento, EVP e marca empregadora, carreiras e cultura.

Quem ensina

Sou Mike, instrutor de RH #1 na Udemy, com 1,800,000+ inscrições em cursos de 170,000 alunos e autor de cerca de 200 livros na Amazon. Estruturei a gestão de pessoas na Preply durante sua trajetória até se tornar um unicórnio e trabalhei na Wargaming, na iDeals e no Alfa-Bank ao longo de 20 anos em RH. Tenho as certificações PHRi, SHRM-CP e HCI sHRBP e represento o HRCI na Europa Oriental.

Já avaliei benefícios para colaboradores considerando tanto o custo quanto o tempo economizado. Na Wargaming, tínhamos um refeitório na empresa e um programa que cobria 50% do custo das refeições. Sem isso, os colaboradores gastavam cerca de uma hora saindo para almoçar. Calculei o valor desse tempo e o comparei com o custo do programa, mostrando por que oferecer refeições poderia ser um investimento em eficiência.

Percorra as três seções na ordem ou abra a aula que atende à sua necessidade atual. Os títulos das seções e das aulas mostram quantas ferramentas você encontra, e a descrição de cada aula lista todas pelo nome.

  • 17 aulas em 3 seções, 7.5 horas
  • 16 recursos para download: apresentações das aulas
  • 133 ferramentas ao longo das aulas
  • Um teste prático de 10 perguntas, um quiz e uma simulação
  • Acesso vitalício a todos os materiais
  • Suporte ativo do instrutor na seção de Q&A
  • Um certificado de conclusão da Udemy

Por onde começar

Liste quanto sua empresa gasta com remuneração, bônus e benefícios por colaborador. Depois, abra a aula sobre estratégia de Total Rewards e faça a avaliação inicial. Inscreva-se agora e comece sua primeira aula hoje.

A pitch deck is a concise and visually engaging presentation that is typically used in business settings to convey a company's or project's key information, value proposition, and investment opportunity. Pitch decks are primarily used when seeking investments, partnerships, or to secure new clients. They serve as a persuasive tool to convey the essence of your business or idea quickly and effectively. A well-crafted pitch deck can make a significant difference in the success of a business, startup, or project.

Here are the key components and the needs of usage for a pitch deck in a business context:

  1. Introduction: Start with a compelling introduction that grabs the audience's attention and provides an overview of your business or project.

  2. Problem Statement: Clearly define the problem or need that your product or service addresses. This sets the stage for why your business is relevant.

  3. Solution: Present your solution and how it addresses the identified problem. Explain how your product or service works and what makes it unique.

  4. Market Opportunity: Describe the market size and potential for your business. This includes the target audience and its demographics.

  5. Business Model: Explain how your business will generate revenue, your pricing strategy, and the sales channels you plan to use.

  6. Traction: Showcase any significant achievements, customer testimonials, or partnerships to build credibility.

  7. Competitive Analysis: Identify your competitors and explain how your business is positioned relative to them. Highlight your competitive advantages.

  8. Team: Introduce your team and their relevant experience. This builds trust and confidence in your ability to execute the business plan.

  9. Financial Projections: Present your financial forecasts, including revenue, expenses, and profitability projections. This demonstrates the potential for a return on investment.

  10. Ask: Clearly state what you are seeking from your audience, whether it's investment, partnership, or something else.


The skills related to pitching, business presenting, and business communication are important for experts and companies for several reasons:

  1. Securing Funding: Effective pitching skills are crucial when seeking investments or funding. A well-presented pitch deck can significantly increase the chances of attracting investors.

  3. Effective Communication: Business communication skills are essential for conveying ideas, plans, and strategies within a company. Clear and persuasive communication can drive team alignment and enhance productivity.

  4. Client Acquisition: In sales and client-facing roles, effective presentation and communication skills can help in acquiring new clients or customers. It can make the difference between a successful pitch and a missed opportunity.

  5. Career Advancement: For individuals, mastering these skills can lead to career advancement. Professionals who can effectively communicate their ideas and lead presentations tend to stand out and progress in their careers.

  6. Team Collaboration: Effective communication and presentation skills are essential for collaboration within teams. They help in conveying objectives, sharing updates, and ensuring everyone is on the same page.


Strong understanding of pitching, business presenting skills, and business communication skills is crucial in today's competitive business environment. These skills not only enable companies to attract investments, win clients, and build credibility but also support the career growth of individuals. A combination of these skills can lead to more successful and impactful business endeavors.

Construis un univers qui te ressemble

Tu commenceras par définir ton thème et ton univers afin de créer une identité qui te correspond réellement, plutôt que de simplement reproduire ce qui fonctionne chez les autres.

Tu découvriras ensuite le rôle du « packaging » : la façon dont une idée, une méthode ou une expertise peut être structurée et présentée pour devenir plus claire, identifiable et mémorable.

Tu verras également comment certaines méthodes connues déclinent un concept central sur différents sujets. L’objectif n’est pas de les copier, mais de comprendre cette logique pour construire ta propre structure et développer progressivement un univers reconnaissable autour de tes projets.

Identifie précisément ton client idéal

Une marque personnelle devient beaucoup plus cohérente lorsqu’elle sait à qui elle parle.

Tu construiras donc le profil détaillé de ton client idéal afin de mieux comprendre ses besoins, ses attentes et la manière dont tu peux t’adresser à lui.

Ce travail te permettra ensuite d’affiner tes contenus, tes offres, ta communication, ta charte et ton slogan pour obtenir un ensemble plus cohérent.

Développe une marque personnelle authentique

Ce cours s’adresse particulièrement aux créateurs de contenu, formateurs, indépendants, auteurs, entrepreneurs et professionnels qui souhaitent mieux affirmer leur singularité et construire une identité plus cohérente autour de leur travail.

courseDetails.title: SMART Goals Parenting

Many parents describe the desires for their children as "I want my kids to be happy" or "I want them to have a good life." But these goals are abstract and difficult to achieve once, let alone repeat.


SMART Goals Parenting breaks these (and other) abstract desires down into their basic foundational components that allow you and your child to achieve happiness, connection, trust and respect... repeatedly.


SMART Goals Parenting's objective is to provide you with the knowledge and tools to cultivate your desired relationship with your child while also preparing your child for being able to one day cultivate happiness and success for him/herself.

You will learn the two SMART goals, which will be your guiding lights are you traverse the terrain of parenthood.


As long as you maintain your focus on what you are ultimately trying to achieve you won't get lost in the minutia.

After learning the SMART goals you will learn how to identify and avoid the pitfalls of choosing fear over love and discarding self-care.


Engaging in these two behaviors will sabotage all of your work. It will be like pouring water into a bottle with no bottom. If you have ever felt unappreciated, unloved, disrespected or criticized for your parenting efforts then I am certain one or both of these barriers are at play.

The next few lessons will tackle guidance.


My goal is to get you to the point when guiding your child is a simple conversation in which both of you feel understood and respected. Until then, you may need these skills to help you navigate.


Choices, Consequences, Rewards and Reinforce (CCRR) are the four parts of seamless discipline.


Streamline how you discipline and remove all power struggles. Doing so will solidify you as your child's respected figure and someone s/he can look up to.


The last, but not least topics covered are the most used parts of communication - listening and speaking. You should listen to understand and speak to build trust.


Many Parents, Myself included have practiced these, eliminating Parenting Stress, following Structured Guidance, helping to Raise Healthy, Confident and Motivated Children.


I look forward to helping you do the same.


Best regards,

Helen V Hicks MA MBA LPC

Licensed Professional Counselor, Parenting Coach

  • Beginner to intermediate users looking to automate workflows or build conversational AI systems.

Outcome
Learners will be able to create functional, AI-powered agents that respond to user queries, help complete tasks, and integrate with business data and services — all within the Copilot ecosystem.

Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry) is a unified enterprise AI platform where developers can build, test, manage, and scale AI applications and agents with robust governance, observability, and tooling support. It combines models, tools, and workflows within a single portal for enterprise-grade AI operations.
